cards.ex: We're living in the digital age, where information is at our fingertips.
cards.exUz: Biz raqamli davrda yashayapmiz, bu erda ma'lumotlar qo'limiz ostida.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalar va internetning keng tarqalgan davri

cards.ex: I found a wireless hotspot at the cafe so I could check my email.
cards.exUz: Men kafeda elektron pochtamni tekshirish uchun simsiz nuqta topdim.
cards.uzDef: Simsiz internetga ulanish imkonini beruvchi joy

cards.ex: Online banking makes it easy to pay bills from home.
cards.exUz: Onlayn bank uyda o'tirib to'lovlarni amalga oshirishni osonlashtiradi.

cards.ex: The music industry has experienced significant digital disruption.
cards.exUz: Musiqa sanoati sezilarli raqamli buzilishni boshdan kechirdi.

cards.ex: I use a virtual assistant to set reminders and play music.
cards.exUz: Men eslatmalar o'rnatish va musiqa ijro etish uchun virtual yordamchidan foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Ovozli buyruqlarni bajaruvchi dastur yoki qurilma

cards.ex: E-commerce has revolutionized the way we shop.
cards.exUz: Elektron tijorat bizning xarid qilish usulimizni tubdan o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali tovarlar va xizmatlarni sotish

cards.ex: The tech giants are investing heavily in artificial intelligence.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya gigantlari sun'iy intellektga katta sarmoya kiritmoqdalar.

cards.ex: Video streaming is a bandwidth-intensive activity.
cards.exUz: Video oqim - bu trafigi yuqori faoliyat.
cards.uzDef: Katta hajmdagi internet trafigini talab qiladigan

cards.ex: Cybercrime is a growing threat to businesses and individuals.
cards.exUz: Kiberjinoyat korxonalar va shaxslar uchun o'sib borayotgan tahdiddir.
cards.uzDef: Kompyuterlar va internet orqali sodir etiladigan jinoyatlar

cards.ex: Companies need to innovate to stay ahead in the market.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar bozorda oldingi safda bo'lish uchun innovatsiyalar yaratishi kerak.

cards.ex: She's a power user of Photoshop, so she can do amazing things.
cards.exUz: U Photoshop dasturining tajribali foydalanuvchisi, shuning uchun u ajoyib narsalarni qila oladi.

cards.ex: The Internet of Things is transforming our homes and cities.
cards.exUz: Narsalar interneti uylarimiz va shaharlarimizni o'zgartirmoqda.

cards.ex: Social networking can be a great way to connect with friends and family.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq do'stlar va oila bilan aloqa qilishning ajoyib usuli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali odamlar bilan aloqa o'rnatish

cards.ex: Data privacy is a major concern in the digital age.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumotlar maxfiyligi raqamli davrda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.

cards.ex: The late 1990s saw a huge tech boom.
cards.exUz: 1990-yillarning oxirlarida katta texnologiya rivoji kuzatildi.

cards.ex: Cloud computing allows businesses to scale their operations easily.
cards.exUz: Bulutli hisoblash korxonalarga o'z faoliyatini osonlikcha kengaytirishga imkon beradi.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali ma'lumotlarni saqlash va ularga kirish

cards.ex: This new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'yin qoidasini o'zgartiruvchidir.

cards.ex: He works at a tech startup developing new apps.
cards.exUz: U yangi ilovalarni ishlab chiquvchi texnologiya startapida ishlaydi.

cards.ex: Protecting your online identity is crucial for privacy.
cards.exUz: Maxfiylik uchun onlayn shaxsingizni himoya qilish juda muhim.

cards.ex: Many investors lost money when the tech bubble burst in 2000.
cards.exUz: 2000-yilda texnologiya pufagi yorilganda ko'plab investorlar pul yo'qotdilar.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya kompaniyalari aksiyalarining haddan tashqari qimmatlashuvi

cards.ex: Digital marketing is essential for reaching today's consumers.
cards.exUz: Raqamli marketing bugungi iste'molchilarga erishish uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali mahsulot va xizmatlarni reklama qilish

cards.ex: I called tech support to fix my computer problem.
cards.exUz: Kompyuterimdagi muammoni hal qilish uchun texnik yordamga qo'ng'iroq qildim.
cards.uzDef: Texnologik muammolarni hal qilishda yordam berish

cards.ex: My phone died right before the meeting, go figure!
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvdan oldin telefonim o'chib qoldi, tushunarsiz!

cards.ex: I like to surf the web in my free time.
cards.exUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda internetda sayr qilishni yoqtiraman.

cards.ex: Data analytics can help businesses make better decisions.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumotlar tahlili korxonalarga yaxshiroq qarorlar qabul qilishga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: There have been a lot of tech layoffs recently.
cards.exUz: Yaqinda texnologiya qisqarishlari ko'p bo'ldi.

cards.ex: We can watch movies on demand through streaming services.
cards.exUz: Biz oqimli xizmatlar orqali filmlarni talab bo'yicha tomosha qilishimiz mumkin.

cards.ex: Digital transformation is changing the way businesses operate.
cards.exUz: Raqamli transformatsiya biznesning ishlash usulini o'zgartirmoqda.

cards.ex: I use a digital wallet to pay for things with my phone.
cards.exUz: Men telefonim bilan narsalarga to'lash uchun raqamli hamyondan foydalanaman.

cards.ex: I dream of living in a smart home one day.
cards.exUz: Men bir kun kelib aqlli uyda yashashni orzu qilaman.
